title: Register to vote
kw: register to vote voting election register of electors voter.ie check the register referendum votar eleição título de eleitor
short: You register, or update your address, online at voter.ie. Everyone aged 18 or over who lives in Ireland can vote in local elections, whatever their nationality.
who: You are 18 or over and ordinarily resident in Ireland. At 16 or 17 you can add yourself to the pending list.
**Other EU citizens:** European and local elections.
need: Your PPS number, to register online without a witness.
steps: Go to **voter.ie** and register or update your details.
Without a PPS number, download the form and have it and your ID witnessed at a Garda station or at your local authority.
Your application must reach your local authority at least 15 days before polling day, not counting Sundays and public holidays.

a: Update your address on voter.ie. You can only be registered at one address.
Update the register with proof of citizenship so that you can vote in every election.

cases.q: I cannot get to a polling station
a: Postal votes are available to some groups, including people who cannot attend because of illness or disability. Apply at least 22 days before polling day.

title: Buy a TV licence
kw: tv licence television licence an post tvlicence licença tv
short: Any home with a television needs a licence: €160 a year. A smart TV used only for streaming still counts; a phone or laptop does not.
facts: Online or at a post office
steps: Buy or renew at **tvlicence.ie**, at any post office, or by phoning (01) 705 8800.
To renew online you need the 17-digit reference number and 5-digit PIN from your reminder.
You can spread the cost by direct debit: monthly, quarterly, half-yearly or yearly.

cases.q: I am over 70 or on a welfare payment
a: You may get a free licence through the [Household Benefits Package](#/s/household-benefits).
Bring your licence and proof of your new address to a post office and it is reissued free, or update it online.

cases.q: What if I do not have one?
a: The fine is up to €1,000, or €2,000 for a later offence. Inspectors can call to your home.

title: Get a dog licence
kw: dog licence dog license pet microchip puppy licença cachorro cão
short: Every dog over 4 months old needs a licence: €20 a year, or €140 for the dog’s lifetime. The dog must also be microchipped before it is 12 weeks old.
steps: Have a vet microchip the dog and register it in your name before it is 12 weeks old.
Buy the licence on **licences.ie** or at a post office once the dog is 4 months old.

a: A general licence covers all the dogs at one address: €400 a year, from your local authority.
No licence: €150. No identification: €200. Dog not under control: €300. Not cleaning up after your dog: €250.

cases.q: My dog is a restricted breed
a: Breeds such as Rottweilers and pit bull terriers must be on a short lead, muzzled in public and led by someone over 16. XL Bully dogs have been banned since 1 October 2024.
